mapper.select: SELECT policy_id as policyId, employee_id as employeeId, std_start_time as stdStartTime, std_end_time as stdEndTime, core_time_start as coreTimeStart, core_time_end as coreTimeEnd, break_time_start as breakTimeStart, break_time_end as breakTimeEnd, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM attendance_policy WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_policy ( employee_id, std_start_time, std_end_time, core_time_start, core_time_end, break_time_start, break_time_end, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{stdStartTime}, #{stdEndTime}, #{coreTimeStart}, #{coreTimeEnd}, #{breakTimeStart}, #{breakTimeEnd}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE std_start_time = VALUES(std_start_time), std_end_time = VALUES(std_end_time), core_time_start = VALUES(core_time_start), core_time_end = VALUES(core_time_end), break_time_start = VALUES(break_time_start), break_time_end = VALUES(break_time_end), updated_at = NOW()
